stories.headline: Dutch court asked to halt Meta smart glasses sales over privacy
stories.subtitle: Dutch consumer groups asked an Amsterdam court Nov 26 to halt sales of Meta's AI glasses, saying wearers can film people without their knowledge. Meta points to the recording light; a ruling is due by Dec 24. Sales continue for now.

stories.headline: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 is $284 in Meta's Black Friday sale — not $254
stories.subtitle: Correction: Gen 2 is 25% off its $379 list price, $284 at meta.com and Amazon through Nov 30. The $254 figure is the $299 Meta Glasses models (Fury, Nova, Capri) at 15% off — a different line, not Gen 2.

stories.headline: Meta's Black Friday sale: 25% off Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2, 15% off Quest 3S
stories.subtitle: Meta's Black Friday sale runs Nov 20–30: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 and Oakley HSTN are 25% off, Vanguard and select Meta Glasses 15% off, and Quest 3S is 15% off from $296.99. Note for customers: Meta Ray-Ban Display and Gen 3 are excluded.

stories.headline: Rent and buy 3D movies on Meta Quest, including Billie Eilish's concert film
stories.subtitle: Quest owners in the US can now rent and buy 3D movies in the TV app on Quest 3 and 3S, including Billie Eilish's HIT ME HARD AND SOFT concert film. With Disney+ 3D streaming already live, 3D on Quest is becoming a real selling point.

stories.headline: Quest 3S + Xbox bundle: meta.com lists $339.98 — check the cart before quoting
stories.subtitle: Meta's blog still lists the Quest 3S 128GB + Xbox Nano controller bundle at $399.98, but meta.com shows $339.98. The in-store price is unverified, so confirm in the cart before quoting either figure to a customer.
